description: **A host lint: no helper function named like a PowerShell alias**: the harness PowerShell tests (`harness/tests/Run-HostTests.ps1`) and the watcher scripts: flag any `function <name>` whose name is a built-in alias (`Get-Alias`), because an alias beats a function of the same name Why: in Empire a helper named `Rd` ran `Remove-Item` and deleted `game.lock` on its first test (empire-remastered `docs/learnings/LEARNINGS_HARNESS.md`); in the next job that changes the host tests anyway Raised: audit 2026-11-03 (napoleon J82 triage, Empire learning 2), 2026-11-04
title: A host lint: no helper function named like a PowerShell alias
